name: Adult Degenerative Kyphosis / Hyperkyphosis
definition: Excessive sagittal spinal curvature that may be postural, degenerative, osteoporotic, fracture-related, Scheuermann-related or secondary to other disease.

typical: Functional or respiratory limitation in severe deformity

redFlags.item: Infection, tumour or rapidly progressive deformity

investigations.principle: Imaging depends on deformity severity and suspected cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI for neurological symptoms or suspected tumour/infection/fracture-related neural compromise.
investigations.radiographs: Standing lateral/full-spine radiographs quantify sagittal alignment.

amber: Severe progressive or neurologically complicated deformity requires spine-specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Postural/deformity phenotype can be documented descriptively; no automatic classical equivalence.

patientEducation.summary: Excessive sagittal spinal curvature that may be postural, degenerative, osteoporotic, fracture-related, Scheuermann-related or secondary to other disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.
